title: The Book of 1 Timothy Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 1 Timothy — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
verses.decoded: I, Paul, am an apostle of Jesus Christ, sent by the command of God our Savior and of the Lord Jesus Christ, who is our hope.

verses.kjv: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.decoded: To Timothy, my true son in the faith: I wish you grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.decoded: When I went to Macedonia, I urged you to stay in Ephesus and instruct certain people not to teach false doctrines.

verses.kjv: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
verses.decoded: Don’t pay attention to myths and endless family histories that cause arguments instead of promoting faith and godly living.

verses.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
verses.decoded: The purpose of this command is love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and sincere faith.

verses.kjv: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
verses.decoded: Some have turned away from these and gotten caught up in meaningless arguments.

verses.kjv: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.decoded: They want to be teachers of the law but don’t understand what they are talking about or the things they confidently claim.

verses.kjv: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.decoded: But we know the law is good if it is used properly.

verses.kjv: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.decoded: We understand that the law is not meant for those who live right, but for the lawless and rebellious, for sinners, ungodly and sinful people, for those who kill their parents, and for murderers.

verses.kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.decoded: It is also for immoral people, those who commit sexual sins with others, kidnappers, liars, people who break their promises, and anything else that goes against true teaching.

verses.kjv: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
verses.decoded: This is all according to the wonderful gospel of the blessed God, which has been entrusted to me.

verses.kjv: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.decoded: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who gave me strength and considered me trustworthy by appointing me to serve.

verses.kjv: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.decoded: I was once a blasphemer, a persecutor, and violent, but I received mercy because I acted out of ignorance and unbelief.

verses.kjv: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: The grace of our Lord was more than enough, along with the faith and love that are found in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.decoded: This is a trustworthy statement, deserving full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and I am the worst of them all.

verses.kjv: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.decoded: But I received mercy for this reason: so that Jesus Christ might show his patience through me as an example to those who would later believe in him and receive eternal life.

verses.kjv: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: Now to the eternal King, immortal and invisible, the only wise God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
verses.decoded: Timothy, I am giving you this responsibility based on the prophecies made about you earlier, so that by them you can fight a good fight.

verses.kjv: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.decoded: Keep holding on to your faith and a clear conscience; some have rejected their faith and ruined themselves.

verses.kjv: Of whom is Hymenæus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.decoded: Two examples are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan so they might learn not to speak against God.

verses.kjv: I EXHORT therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.decoded: I urge you, first of all, to make requests, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings for everyone.

verses.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.decoded: Pray especially for kings and all those in authority, so that we may live peaceful and quiet lives, full of godliness and dignity.

verses.kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
verses.decoded: This kind of prayer is good and pleasing to God our Savior.

verses.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.decoded: God wants everyone to be saved and to understand the truth.

verses.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.decoded: There is only one God, and one mediator between God and people—the man Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.decoded: He gave himself as a ransom for everyone, which will be revealed at the right time.

verses.kjv: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.decoded: I have been appointed as a preacher and apostle—I tell the truth in Christ and do not lie—to teach the Gentiles faith and truth.

verses.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.decoded: So I want men everywhere to pray, lifting up pure hands without anger or arguing.

verses.kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
verses.decoded: Similarly, women should dress modestly, with decency and self-control—not with fancy hairstyles, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes.

verses.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.decoded: Instead, they should show their godliness through good deeds.

verses.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.decoded: Let a woman learn quietly and with full respect.

verses.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.decoded: I do not allow a woman to teach or to take authority over a man; she must remain quiet.

verses.kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.decoded: This is because Adam was created first, then Eve.

verses.kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.decoded: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and became a sinner.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.decoded: However, she will be saved through having children if she continues in faith, love, holiness, and self-control.

verses.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.decoded: This saying is trustworthy: if a man wants to be a church leader, he desires a good and honorable task.

verses.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.decoded: A church leader must be above reproach, faithful to one wife, alert, self-controlled, well-behaved, welcoming to guests, and able to teach.

verses.kjv: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.decoded: He must not be addicted to alcohol, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain; instead, he should be patient, not argumentative, and not a lover of money.

verses.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.decoded: He should manage his own family well, with his children showing proper respect and discipline.

verses.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.decoded: Because if someone cannot lead their own family, how can they care for God's church?

verses.kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.decoded: He should not be a new believer, so that he does not become proud and fall under the devil’s judgment.

verses.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.decoded: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so he will not bring disgrace on the church or fall into the devil’s trap.

verses.kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.decoded: Deacons must also be serious, honest in speech, not addicted to much wine, and not greedy for dishonest gain.

verses.kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.decoded: They must hold firmly to the deep truths of the faith with a clear and sincere conscience.

verses.kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
verses.decoded: Let them be tested first, and if found blameless, then let them serve as deacons.

verses.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.decoded: In the same way, their wives must be serious, not gossipers, self-controlled, and faithful in everything.

verses.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.decoded: Deacons should be faithful to one wife and manage their children and households well.

verses.kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: Those who serve well as deacons earn respect and gain confidence in their faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.decoded: I am writing these instructions to you, hoping to visit you soon.

verses.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.decoded: But if I am delayed, you will know how people should conduct themselves in God’s household—the church of the living God, which is the foundation and support of the truth.

verses.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.decoded: There is no doubt that the mystery of true godliness is great: God appeared in human form, was declared righteous by the Spirit, was witnessed by angels, was preached to the Gentiles, was believed in throughout the world, and was taken up into glory.

verses.kjv: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.decoded: The Spirit clearly says that in the last days some people will abandon the faith and follow deceptive spirits and teachings from demons.

verses.kjv: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.decoded: They will lie and act hypocritically, having a conscience that is so hardened it no longer feels guilt.

verses.kjv: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.decoded: They will forbid marriage and order people to avoid certain foods, which God created to be eaten with gratitude by those who believe and understand the truth.

verses.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.decoded: Everything God made is good and should not be rejected if it is accepted with thankfulness.

verses.kjv: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
verses.decoded: Because it is made holy through God's word and prayer.

verses.kjv: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
verses.decoded: If you remind the believers of these truths, you will be a good servant of Christ, growing strong in faith and sound teaching that you have learned.

verses.kjv: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.decoded: Avoid worthless myths and old wives' tales; instead, train yourself to live a godly life.

verses.kjv: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.decoded: Physical exercise has some value, but living a godly life is valuable in every way, promising blessings now and in the future.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.decoded: This saying is trustworthy and deserves full acceptance.

verses.kjv: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.decoded: That’s why we work hard and endure insults, because we trust in the living God, who saves everyone, especially those who believe.

verses.kjv: These things command and teach.
verses.decoded: Teach and instruct people to follow these things.

verses.kjv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.decoded: Don’t let anyone look down on you because you are young. Instead, be an example to believers in what you say, how you live, your love, your faith, and your purity.

verses.kjv: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.decoded: Until I arrive, devote yourself to reading Scripture, encouraging others, and teaching sound doctrine.

verses.kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.decoded: Don’t neglect the spiritual gift you received when the elders laid their hands on you during prophecy.

verses.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
verses.decoded: Think deeply about these things and devote yourself fully to them, so that your progress will be evident to everyone.

verses.kjv: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
verses.decoded: Be careful to watch over yourself and your teaching; keep following them. By doing this, you will save both yourself and those who listen to you.

verses.kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
verses.decoded: Do not criticize an older man harshly; instead, treat him like a father. Treat younger men like brothers.

verses.kjv: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.decoded: Treat older women like mothers, and younger women like sisters, with complete purity.

verses.kjv: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.decoded: Give special respect to widows who are truly widows in need.

verses.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
verses.decoded: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should take care of their own family first, showing kindness and repaying their parents, which pleases God.

verses.kjv: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.decoded: A true widow who is lonely and without support puts her hope in God and prays constantly, day and night.

verses.kjv: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
verses.decoded: But a widow who lives selfishly and indulges in pleasure is spiritually dead even while she is alive.

verses.kjv: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.decoded: Give these instructions so that they will have no fault or blame.

verses.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.decoded: If anyone does not take care of their own family, especially their household, they have rejected the faith and are worse than an unbeliever.

verses.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.decoded: Do not enroll a widow as a church-supported widow unless she is at least 60 years old and has been married to only one man.

verses.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.decoded: She must have a good reputation for good deeds: raising children, welcoming strangers, washing the feet of believers, helping those in trouble, and faithfully doing good works.

verses.kjv: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
verses.decoded: But reject younger widows because when they become careless about Christ, they want to remarry.

verses.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.decoded: They bring judgment on themselves because they have abandoned their initial faith.

verses.kjv: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.decoded: They also become lazy, going from house to house, gossiping and meddling in things they shouldn’t.

verses.kjv: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.decoded: So I want younger women to marry, have children, manage their homes, and avoid giving enemies any reason to criticize the church.

verses.kjv: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.decoded: Because some have already turned away and followed Satan.

verses.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.decoded: If any believing man or woman has widows in their family, they should take care of them so the church doesn't have to bear the responsibility. This way, the church can help those widows who truly have no one else to support them.

verses.kjv: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.decoded: Elders who lead the church well should be given special respect, especially those who work hard teaching and preaching God's word.

verses.kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
verses.decoded: The Scriptures say, 'Don't stop an ox from eating while it works,' and 'A worker deserves to be paid for their work.'

verses.kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.decoded: Don't accept accusations against an elder unless there are two or three witnesses to confirm it.

verses.kjv: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.decoded: Correct those who sin openly in front of everyone, so that others will be warned and afraid to do wrong.

verses.kjv: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.decoded: I solemnly urge you, in the presence of God, Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, to follow these instructions without favoritism or bias.

verses.kjv: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.decoded: Don't quickly appoint someone to a position of leadership, and don't share in others' sins; keep yourself morally clean.

verses.kjv: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.
verses.decoded: Stop drinking only water; use a little wine to help with your stomach problems and frequent illnesses.

verses.kjv: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
verses.decoded: Some people's sins are obvious and lead to judgment quickly, while others' sins become known later.

verses.kjv: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
verses.decoded: Similarly, some people's good deeds are clear and well known in advance, but those who do wrong cannot hide their actions.

verses.kjv: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.decoded: All servants who are under authority should respect their masters fully, so that God's name and teachings are not dishonored.

verses.kjv: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
verses.decoded: If your masters believe in Christ, don’t look down on them because they are your brothers; instead, serve them well because they are dear to God and share in the blessings. Teach and encourage this.

verses.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.decoded: If anyone teaches differently and does not agree with the healthy teachings, especially the words of Jesus and godly doctrine,

verses.kjv: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
verses.decoded: That person is arrogant and ignorant, obsessed with arguments and quarrels that lead to jealousy, fights, insults, and evil suspicions.

verses.kjv: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
verses.decoded: They engage in twisted arguments, have corrupt minds, lack truth, and wrongly think that being godly is about making money. Stay away from people like that.

verses.kjv: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.decoded: But living a godly life with satisfaction is truly valuable.

verses.kjv: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.decoded: We came into this world with nothing, and we will leave with nothing.

verses.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.decoded: If we have food and clothing, we should be satisfied with that.

verses.kjv: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.decoded: But those who want to get rich fall into temptation and traps, and many foolish and harmful desires that destroy people.

verses.kjv: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.decoded: The love of money causes all kinds of evil. Some who wanted money have turned away from their faith and caused themselves much pain.

verses.kjv: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.decoded: But you, man of God, avoid these things and instead pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and gentleness.

verses.kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.decoded: Fight the good fight of faith and hold on to eternal life, which God has called you to, and which you have openly declared before many people.

verses.kjv: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
verses.decoded: I command you before God, who gives life to everything, and before Jesus Christ, who made a good confession before Pontius Pilate,

verses.kjv: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: Keep this command without fault or blame until the Lord Jesus Christ appears.

verses.kjv: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
verses.decoded: At the right time, God will show who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

verses.kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.decoded: He alone has eternal life and lives in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him or can see Him. To Him be everlasting honor and power. Amen.

verses.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.decoded: Tell those who are wealthy in this life not to be proud or put their trust in unstable wealth, but to trust in the living God, who generously gives us everything to enjoy.

verses.kjv: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.decoded: They should do good, be rich in good deeds, ready to share, and willing to help others.

verses.kjv: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.decoded: By doing this, they are building a strong foundation for the future so they can truly grasp eternal life.

verses.kjv: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
verses.decoded: Timothy, guard the teachings entrusted to you. Stay away from worthless and silly arguments and from debates based on false knowledge.

verses.kjv: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
verses.decoded: Some who claim this knowledge have wandered away from the true faith. May grace be with you. Amen.
